description: Estadísticas de Movimientos de Embarcaciones, 2018 - 2026 is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Portuaria Dominicana (APORDOM). En este conjunto de datos se encuentra las Estadísticas del Movimiento de Embarcaciones que ingresan a la República Dominicana, generadas en el periodo 2018-2026, en el cual se puede encontrar una relación de la cantidad de embarcaciones que ingresan al país tanto en los puertos privados, concesionados y del estado. Coverage: República Dominicana. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Portuaria Dominicana (APORDOM). Its tags are Economía, Puertos, Transporte Marítimo. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
